title: Research exact Q8 mixed-unit register minimum
body:
## Result

This adds an exact finite minimum for the target `diag(i,j,k)` over the abstract noncommutative register alphabet `F2[Q8]`, with factors `D_N(g)=I+(g+1)N`, all 28 binary rank-one idempotents, and every nonidentity Q8 label. The one-factor census covers 196 words and the ordered two-factor census covers 38,416; neither contains the target. A direct three-factor word realizes it, so the minimum is three under the stated unit-per-factor convention. The nearest two-factor outputs have coefficient Hamming distance two, attained by six words.

This is scoped finite evidence only. It does not identify a physical supplier, charge an all-size interface, or change the selected conditional bound or kappa.

## Relationship to open Q8 work

Open [PR #2248](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2248) studies `diag(-1,-1,i/j)` and `diag(-1,-1,-1)` using paid labels `{i,j}`. This package studies the distinct target `diag(i,j,k)` and exhausts lengths one and two with all seven nonidentity Q8 labels.

## Pins and reproduction

- Seed `189ad74f7eb7b99d43830c0ed0f15958`, track `bit-mechanisms`, task `bit-new-register-model`, priority revision 4.
- Base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; selected-record SHA-256 `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.
- `python3 -I -O -B research/bit-q8-three-register-two-call-seed189ad74/search.py`
- `python3 -I -O -B research/bit-q8-three-register-two-call-seed189ad74/verify.py`
- `python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-q8-three-register-two-call-seed189ad74 --check-only`

The exact search and independent set-based replay pass on CPython 3.14.7; the package metadata and source pins pass. The registered package replay targets Python 3.12, which is unavailable locally; hosted replay remains pending.

The original scope claim is [Discussion #2300](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2300). Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance.
